title: Ear Ringing (Tinnitus)
blurb: A high, thin eeeeee where the world used to be. Film grammar established this as the standard signal for concussed disorientation — the audience hears what the character hears, which is very nearly nothing — and edits inherited the technique wholesale. Play it after loud chaos, after news that has not been processed yet, or after an alarm's third snooze at a time nobody should be conscious. It is realistic enough that a fair number of listeners check their own ears afterwards, which is either impressive or unforgivable.
